rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone watching a spectacle or television.

example.english: I am a viewer of this TV program every night.
example.traditional: 我每晚都係呢個電視節目的觀眾。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 maan5 dou1 hai6 nei1 go3 din6 si6 zit3 muk6 dik1 gun1 zung3

rows.note: Use this for an onlooker who is standing by and observing rather than taking part in the event.

example.english: I was just a viewer standing to the side while they fought.
example.traditional: 佢哋打交嗰陣，我只係企喺側邊嘅旁觀者。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 daa2 gaau1 go2 zan6 ngo5 zi2 hai6 kei5 hai2 zak1 bin1 ge3 pong4 gun1 ze2
